```kotlin
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader

fun main() {
    val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`))
    val line1 = reader.readLine().split(" ")
    val n1 = line1[0].toLong()
    val n2 = line1[1].toLong()
    val n = reader.readLine().toInt()
    var idx = (n - 1) % 6
    var neg = false
    var current = n1
    if (idx >= 3) {
        neg = true
        idx -= 3
    }
    when (idx) {
        1 -> current = n2
        2 -> current = n2 - n1
    }
    if (neg) {
        current = -current
    }
    val mod = 1000000007L
    println((current % mod + mod) % mod)
}
```
